Let tools carry the admin.
Keep people in the story.

AI can help prepare briefs, comparisons and release material. People choose the creative direction and the commitments they make.

A clear task.
A concrete result.

Give an agent the intended result, source records, allowed actions, spending or publication limits and a person to contact for exceptions.

Existing permissions carry forward inside their agreed scope. A changed task or exception returns to the relevant person. Permissions can be paused or revoked.

A compact handoff

Record reference and version.

Work completed and next task.

Unresolved questions.

Permitted actions and limits.

The human decision and verified result.

From a making story
to a media release.

Use the product record to keep the words, images, specifications and credits consistent.

01

Collect and organise

Bring footage, sound, music, artwork and the brief into one package. Keep source, context, permitted use and destinations attached.

02

Assemble and shape

Prepare selections, an edit map, captions and output layouts. Choose the asset bundle for Aura, P4A, GAJRA Earth or the participating club. Review a style frame before applying it across a batch.

03

Check and deliver

Review captions against the recording and watch the complete export. Supply filenames, credits, descriptions and permissions for each agreed destination.

Useful now.
Ready to connect later.

The workbench creates an editable task brief and a release pack from your product record. It records permission status, but does not execute the task.
